label: Oestradiol
biological_meaning: E2 present in the culture medium (published regimen: 10 nM).

label: Progestin
biological_meaning: Progesterone (hormone-only regimen) or MPA (published regimen: 1 uM) present.

label: XAV939
biological_meaning: Tankyrase inhibitor present (published regimen: 10 uM). Read by no rule (OQ-01).

label: BMP receptor inhibitor
biological_meaning: BMP type I receptor inhibitor present (WP1 Task 1.4; compound not fixed).

label: IL-1beta
biological_meaning: IL-1beta present (G2 inflammation model; dose not fixed).

label: Epithelial PGR activity
biological_meaning: Ligand-activated progesterone receptor signalling in epithelial cells.

label: Epithelial IHH
biological_meaning: Indian hedgehog expressed by epithelium and acting on stroma.

label: Stromal PGR activity
biological_meaning: Ligand-activated progesterone receptor signalling in stromal cells.

label: Stromal cAMP/PKA
biological_meaning: cAMP-dependent protein kinase signalling in stromal cells.

label: Stromal COUP-TFII
biological_meaning: NR2F2 response downstream of Hedgehog reception and PGR.

label: BMP receptor/SMAD1/5/8 activity
biological_meaning: BMP receptor signalling and SMAD1/5/8 phosphorylation.

label: Stromal paracrine mitogen
biological_meaning: Stromal mitogenic signal acting on epithelium; ligand identity unresolved (FGF family candidates).

label: Stromal IL-1 receptor signalling
biological_meaning: IL-1 receptor signalling activity; ERK1/2, JNK and NF-kappaB routes not distinguished.

label: Epithelial secretory differentiation
biological_meaning: Secretory differentiation program of the epithelium.

label: Stromal decidualization
biological_meaning: Decidual differentiation program of the stroma.
